messages:
carla: Heads up 1: Weve been talking with Surfline about a short customer case. Theyre willing to be featured if we get a cleaned quote + one verified metric and a short NDA-lite approval email. Can we organize?
diego: Ill schedule a 20-min interview for Thurs 11am PT with their eng lead, Priya.
marta: Ill own the narrative and questions. Important: ask about the latency tail and cost-per-transaction drop after switching to Redwood Dedicated.
leo: I can pull the numbers. Do we want absolute numbers (ms/$) or percent delta? Either works but percent is easier for social.
carla: Percent for social, absolute for the case page. Example: "p99 from 480ms to 130ms (73% reduction)" and "cost per inference down 35%" if theyre comfortable.
terry-legal: Quick legal flag: if they mention percentages tied to cost, ensure the customer confirms the financial data and add a short consent line in the email. I can prepare a one-paragraph approval template.
diego: Interview calendar invite sent to Priya + product ops. Ill attach the Qs.
marta: Draft quote (internal):

"Redwood Dedicated gave us the predictable tail latency and cost efficiency we needed to scale real-time personalization across our platform." 

Thoughts?
carla: Tone is good. Make it a bit more specific: mention "real-time personalization" is great. Add an attribution: "1Priya, Eng Lead, Surfline".
leo: Pulled the last-14-day p99 and cost snapshot from telemetry. Raw: p99=128ms post, 490ms pre; avg cost/inference $0.0031 post, $0.0048 pre. Ill round for customer-facing numbers.
marta: Nice. Ill send the draft quote + numbers to Priya after we have the approval email template from @terry-legal.
terry-legal: Template sent to thread (copy pasted below). Use it verbatim for approvals: "I, [NAME], on behalf of [COMPANY], approve the use of the following quote and metrics in Redwood Inference marketing materials: [QUOTE] [METRICS]. I confirm these are accurate to the best of my knowledge."
carla: Perfect. Also need headshot + company logo; @assets-bot can you confirm preferred file formats once we get them?
assets-bot: Noted. Preferred formats: headshot=400x400 jpg, logo=svg + png(1x,2x). Upload path will be /marketing/case-studies/surfline/ when ready.
diego: Priya replied and approved the interview time; asked for questions in advance. I forwarded the draft quote and metrics and asked for approval per Terrys template.
priaya: [off-channel reply forwarded by diego] "Okay to share numbers and quote; will send signed approval email after review."
marta: Great. Once we have the signed line, plan: 1) publish a one-paragraph highlight on the blog + long-form case page, 2) a short LinkedIn + X social post, 3) add a line in the next benchmark narrative pointing to the Surfline story. Also check with Growth for a possible joint webinar.
leo: I prepared two versions of the metric language: precise and relaxed. Precise: "p99 latency reduced from 490ms to 128ms (74% reduction); cost per inference reduced by 35%". Relaxed: "cut p99 latency by ~75% and costs by ~35%". Which should we send?
carla: Send precise to the customer for approval, but we can use relaxed wording for social if they prefer anonymity.
terry-legal: Agreed. Also add: remove any internal roadmap or competitor references. Ill review their approval email and confirm once its on file.
diego: Priya sent the approval email with the template copy pasted and her name + title. Forwarded to Terry.
terry-legal: Received. Clause check done. No red flags. Cleared for publish. Ive attached a short note about attributions: use exact wording they provided for the quote but we may shorten it for social with their OK.
marta: Social draft: "Surfline cut p99 by ~75% after migrating to Redwood Dedicated, enabling real-time personalization at scale. Read the case study -> <link>" Any edits?
leo: Maybe add a parenthetical stat: (p99 from 490ms to 128ms). Good to have both corp and technical audiences.
carla: Scheduling: target publish next Wednesday 9am PT. Diego, confirm assets upload and Priya headshot by Monday EOD.
diego: Confirmed. Ill nudge Priya for headshot and logo.
assets-bot: Uploaded placeholder banner + template: /marketing/case-studies/surfline/assets/placeholder_banner.png
marta: OK team, checklist: legal approval (done), quote + metrics (approved by customer), assets (waiting), social + blog drafts (marta/sam), inbound routing: tag leads "surfline-case" and route to Growth SDRs.
carla: Thanks folks. Once assets are live, Ill schedule the posts and ping Growth to expect the routing rule.
diego: Priya uploaded headshot and logo via email. I uploaded them to the assets folder.
assets-bot: Uploaded: headshot-400x400.jpg, logo-srgb.svg, banner-1200x628.png to /marketing/case-studies/surfline/assets/ :white_check_mark:
marta: Final copy for case page ready. Social scheduled for Wed 9am PT. Routing rule created in HubSpot: tag=surfline-case -> assign Growth-SDRs, add property case_source=surfline.
carla: Ship it. Thanks everyone! :tada:
